# smallstep_wifi (Data Source)

Configuration to use a credential to connect to a protected Wi-Fi network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smallstep_wifi" "my_wireless_net" {
  id = "0c842718-3250-49b0-a375-94dded1eee75"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of this protected Wi-Fi configuration.

### Read-Only

- `autojoin` (Boolean) Whether or not clients should automatically connect to the network.
- `credentials` (Set of String) The UUID of credentials that the Smallstep agent will configure to use this Wi-Fi integration.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether or not the SSID is broadcast by the access points.
- `name` (String) A human-friendly display name for this resource.
- `radius_server_ca` (String) The certificate bundle used to verify the RADIUS server.
- `radius_server_domain` (String) Require the RADIUS server certificate to contain this DNS name as a SAN or CommonName. Supported on Windows.
- `ssid` (String) The name of the wireless network that clients connect to.
